description: Java class defining REST API endpoints for managing provisioning categories in the Fineract platform, including retrieve all, create, update, and delete operations.

classes.name: ProvisioningCategoryApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for provisioning category operations, including retrieve all, create, update, and delete.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all provisioning categories.

methods.name: createProvisioningCategory
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new provisioning category.

methods.name: updateProvisioningCategory
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing provisioning category identified by categoryId.

methods.name: deleteProvisioningCategory
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a provisioning category identified by categoryId.
